stories.title: The rare Nintendo Switch 2 case that still fits into the official dock.
stories.summary:
I’ve been testing Belkin’s Charging Grip, the latest in the company’s unexpectedly good run of Nintendo Switch 2 products. The components are solid; each Joy-Con 2 snugly slides into its thick, comfort-adding grips, and the console shell fits just right. Being able to still slide the Switch 2 into Nintendo’s dock makes this case worth recommending if you split your time spent gaming evenly between handheld and docked modes. Plus, it comes in some nice colors, including the purple one that Belkin sent us.
[Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/belkin2.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]
[Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/belkin3.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]
[Image: https://platform.theverge.com/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/11/belkin4.jpg?quality=90&strip=all]
The $99.99 set (Amazon, Best Buy) includes a 10,000mAh 30W USB-C battery that magnetically attaches to the back of the console (the grip without the battery is $39.99). The battery, while convenient, isn’t essential considering how much it adds to the somewhat already-high cost.
